# Copperfield Foods — Line 2 Shift Production Schedule
08/17/2026 | Day shift | Prepared by Gordon Banerjee

## Shift targets
The shift runs from 6:00 AM to 2:30 PM at Copperfield Foods' Albany, New York, plant. Lucas Osei is the Line 2 lead; Andre Lindqvist operates the filler. The target is 480 cases, with finished cases labeled by lot and staged in the marked outbound area. The team will record hourly counts and downtime on the line log. Gordon Banerjee will review the log at shift end and report any shortfall to planning.

## Sequence and assignments
- Tuesday, 08/17/2026: start Line 2 with the sesame tahini hummus order, 240 cases, lot TH817.
- At 10:00 AM, switch to chickpea spread.
- Produce 240 cases of chickpea spread, lot CS817, after the changeover; complete the run by 1:45 PM.
- Lucas verifies the lot code and case count at startup and after each product change. Andre records the filler checks and hourly production totals.
- Reserve 1:45–2:15 PM for line cleanup and staging; use 2:15–2:30 PM for handoff to the afternoon lead.

## Staffing and constraints
Both operators are assigned to the full shift. The supervisor will assign a qualified relief operator for each scheduled meal period so the line can maintain coverage. Copperfield's allergen-control work instruction requires a documented, verified equipment clean between sesame-containing and non-sesame products; include that step in the production sequence. Do not combine lots or use cases with unreadable labels. If equipment downtime exceeds 15 minutes, notify maintenance and record the start time, end time, and cause before restarting. Keep the sesame tahini run's labeled cases physically separated from the chickpea spread run during staging and pallet wrap.
